text: Chemical Engineering is an engineering discipline based on chemistry, physics and mathematics, which studies the laws of material transformation and energy transfer. Its core task is to transform the chemical reactions, separation and purification technologies in the laboratory into large-scale and highly efficient industrial production processes. For example, petroleum is "cracked" into basic chemical raw materials such as ethylene, and then plastics are produced through polymerization reactions; Or design the electrolyte formula for lithium batteries and optimize the electrode preparation process. Compared with the chemistry major, chemical engineering places more emphasis on "industrial scale-up" and "process optimization", addressing engineering challenges from "laboratory small-scale trials" to "factory mass production".
